meta.title: Routina — Your offline daily planner
meta.description: Plan your schedule, tasks, and routines in one offline-first Android app.

ui.alt: Routina Home and Calendar on two blue phones

overview.label: Product overview
overview.title: One app. A more organized day.
items: Keep deadlines and next steps in view.
Make time for habits that matter.

features.label: Main features
features.title: Tools for the day ahead.
items: Move between month, week, and day views.
Break a task into smaller steps and track its deadline.
Set goals and record time spent.
Review available slots for your tasks.
Choose when your device reminds you.

spot.label: Smart Scheduling
spot.body: Routina weighs your active hours, existing plans, task deadline, and estimated work time.
spot.note: You review each slot and approve it before Routina adds it to your schedule.

routine.label: Routine tracking
routine.title: Build a rhythm that fits your day.
routine.body: Set a goal for study or exercise. Start the timer when you begin, then see how the time you actually spent compares with your plan.

stats.label: Productivity statistics
stats.title: See your progress clearly.
stats.body: Review daily, weekly, or monthly activity. Figures below are a weekly demo.

privacy.label: Privacy & offline
privacy.title: Your plans. Your device.
privacy.body: Your planner works locally, without an online account.
items: Your planner data stays in the app’s local database.
Open the offline planner and start with your own schedule.
Choose a password and where to export your backup. Restore it when you need it.

gallery.label: App screenshots
gallery.title: A closer look at Routina.
gallery.body: Original app designs with sample planner data.

steps.label: How it works
steps.title: Get started in three steps.
items: Once the public release is available, get the official Android package here.
Open the APK and follow Android’s installer and device security checks.
Set your active hours, add a task, and make room for your first routine.

download.label: Android download
download.title: Ready for a more organized day?
download.body: Routina for Android is in release preview. The public download opens after approval.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
items: Routina is an offline-first Android planner for your calendar, tasks, and daily routines.
Pricing for the public release has yet to be announced.
Yes. Plan your day, run routine timers, and review your progress using data on your device.
The offline version works without an online account.
How do I install it on Android?
Once published, download the official APK. Open it and follow the Android installer and its security checks.
Choose a password and export an encrypted backup to a location you control. Restore it with the file and its password.
Will an update keep my data?
Back up first. Updates require a compatible signed APK with a higher version code. Signed upgrade testing is pending.
This preview is for Android. Native iOS testing is pending.

end.label: Routina for Android
end.title: Make room for your next good day.
